newsitem.title: USA: Tesoro Petroleum unit buys two fields.
newsitem.headline: Tesoro Petroleum unit buys two fields.

text.p: Tesoro Petroleum Corp said Tuesday that a wholly owned subsidiary has purchased a 50 percent interest in portions of two oil and gas fields in South Texas for $15 million.
The fields are located in Hidalgo and Starr counties. They were purchased from an undisclosed party.

The Tesoro interest in the two fields, which are in the Frio/Vicksburg trend, covers 11,000 acres with current production averaging more than 17 million cubic feet of gas equivalent per day. Net proved reserves are estimated at 21 billion cubic feet equivalent.
The acquisition is 90 percent natural gas, it said.
Tesoro said it will jointly operate the fields with a private producer.
